title: 3-packings in Triangulations: Algorithms, bounds, and Complexity
summary: We study $H$-packings in plane triangulations for the three-vertex graphs $H\in\{P_3,K_3,P_2\cup P_1\}$. For a graph $H$, let $λ_H(G)$ denote the maximum size of an $H$-packing in $G$, with the convention that for $H=P_2\cup P_1$ the copies are required to be induced. For $P_3$-packings, we prove that every triangulation $G$ on $n$ vertices satisfies $λ_{P_3}(G)\ge \left\lfloor \frac n5\right\rfloor$, and show that this lower bound is asymptotically tight.
